title: An efficient and rigorous criterion for the admissible time step of deforming grids in generalized Lagrangian and ALE methods
summary: It is mathematically proved that, for a grid under a boundary-preserving piecewise-smooth deformation, the positivity of the Jacobian determinant in each closed element is also a sufficient condition for the deformed grid to remain valid. Most of the proof is devoted to showing that the element-wise positivity of the Jacobian indeed induces a local isomorphism in the grid-deformation setting. This result provides users of ALE methods and of the generalized Lagrangian method with a clean answer: checking the Jacobian alone is enough to determine the validity of the deformed grid.
